notes.title: Some QoL changes!
notes.content:
Small Quality of Life changes have been made to improve the experience:

[list]
[*] Global sound volume has been reduced by 50%.
[*] Puzzle 3 of Chapter 4 has been reworked.
[*] Puzzle 3 of Chapter 5 has been reworked.
[*] A small visual bug has been fixed in Chapter 1-9.
[*] Boss HP bar is now easier to spot.
[/list]

We improve this game constantly to improve the experience of all the recent new players but also the ones that have not been able to beat the game yet! There's a lot more changes coming! Thanks for playing The Legend of Chibi Ninja!

notes.title: The NIGHTMARE is finally over...
notes.content:
Chapter 5 was the LAST chapter for the vast majority of The Legend of Chibi Ninja Players

Let's see the numbers:

-[b]100%[/b] of Players that beat Chapter 5 also beat Chapter 6 and Chapter 7.
-83.87% of Players that beat Chapter 5 finish the WHOLE game.

Chapter 5's difficulty spike was nerfed TWICE already, obviously it wasn't enough. This time the changes are VERY noticeable.

If you are one of the 80.40% that are still stuck in Chapter 5, please dust off your ninja skills and bomb shurikens and try again to experience the second and BEST HALF of the game... There's a reason 100% ([b]ONE HUNDRED PERCENT![/b]) of the Players that managed to beat the old spooky Chapter 5 also beat the next two Chapters equally.

The Legend of Chibi Ninja is a RUTHLESS game. However, it doesn't feel right to have the vast majority of players get stuck JUST before the part of the game where s**t hits the fan.

The NIGHTMARE is finally over...Chapter 5 is not the hardest Chapter in the game by far anymore.


¡Thanks for playing The Legend of Chibi Ninja!





[i]Oh, a Puzzle of Chapter 4 was also slightly nerfed.[/i]

notes.title: ACHIEVEMENTS ARE HERE!
notes.content:
[b]ACHIEVEMENTS ARE HERE![/b]

My most sincere apologies, took way longer than I thought it would, however you should NOT worry about having to play the whole game from scratch to get your achievements. Players that have progressed through the game already will get their corresponding achievements as soon as Chibi Ninja appears on the screen again as if achievements were available from the get-go! Took a little longer than expected to get the logic behind it.

Compensation should look as follows:

Prison Finished - Prison Escape achievement
Chapter 1 - Boss 1 Achievement + 30 enemies killed
Chapter 2 - Boss 2 Achievement + 50 enemies killed
Chapter 3 - Boss 3 Achievement + 100 enemies killed
Chapter 4 - Boss 4 Achievement + 150 enemies killed
Chapter 5 - Boss 5 Achievement + 200 enemies killed
Chapter 6 - Boss 6 Achievement + 250 enemies killed
Chapter 7 - Boss 7 Achievement + 250 enemies killed
Chapter 8 - Corresponding Achievement with corresponding number of deaths

Specific action achievements such as finding extremely secret places for the first time should be visisted again to get their specific achievement.

[b]MORE CHANGES[/b]

[list]
[*] Instructions on how to reset a room have been added to Castle 2.
[*] MummaMia Speed: [b]1.50 -> 1.45 [/b]
[*] Mumma Mia Resurrection: [b]300F -> 330F[/b]
[*] Better lightning in World 5's Background
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.1
notes.content:
World 5 proved to be a very tough difficulty spike for a lot of players.

-World 5 is now less unforgiving, to compensate, however, completely NEW rooms were added to World 6's Castle which used to be very short. This should make the difficulty spike a lot smoother.

-Fixed a bug where Purple Spitter's bullets failed to target Chibi Ninja if he died on the same frame as they were shooting in World 5, resulting in a crash.

-Deleted some developer tools that found their way on the last build on a massive oversight. One of them allowed to beat the game 100% with the press of a single button, the other allowed to skip rooms via a combination of keys. Luckily, no one found out.

notes.title: CHIBI NINJA IS OFICIALLY OUT!!
notes.content:
It's been 5 long years of sweat and blood of solo development but it's finally here!

I hope you LOVE the game as much as I do. It might prove to be REALLY difficult at times, but once you master CHIBI NINJA's abilities you'll feel INVINCIBLE.

The real highlight of this game is the MULTIPLAYER mode, it's impossible to express in a trailer or in words how fun it is, but trust me, it's always 100% HILARIOUS so... grab a friend and get ready for the biggest adventure with the smallest NINJA!
